title: Stasis Vellum
description: A hooded figure stands in the doorway of a mysterious shop during a heavy rainstorm. Above, a glowing white cat with cyan eyes floats within a massive swirling vortex of teal scorpions and leaves, while a white wolf howls in the foreground.
prompt: A dark fantasy scene in heavy rain, a hooded figure holding open the door of a shop called Stasis Vellum with signs for Garden Spells and Lobster Accessories. In the sky a giant swirling vortex of teal scorpions and leaves surrounds a glowing white cat with bright cyan eyes and lightning aura. A white wolf howls in the wet foreground. Moody, atmospheric, detailed illustration.
